name: PiCaRad
description: Abstract Purpose: To develop PiCaRad, a standardized radiomics-ready prostate MRI resource that facilitates reproducible radiomics research by providing analysis-ready feature matrices, harmonized clinical annotations, and reference benchmark experiments. Methods: PiCaRad was constructed from the publicly available PI-CAI and Prostate158 datasets using a unified PyRadiomics pipeline.
